UX-17: Version 2 shell, slice 1a with Daniel's changes

For Daniel, through B.E.R.N.I.S.S. Branch feature/ux-17-v2-shell (0b35919), stacked on feature/v2-gate (d3a1554). Synthetic demo data, CA account, Version 2 switched on.

  • Classic, V2 off, Kavitha's classic-compare: 56 of 56 identical
  • Sidebar from 1024 px, sheet below
  • Space pages listed under their space
  • No permission, route or migration

What changed since the first look

  • Sidebar from 1024 px. Tablets from 768 to 1023 px get the sheet and the full width.
  • Below 640 px the top bar is menu, search icon, branch and avatar. The way back is "Back to Classic layout" in the menu sheet footer, and "Use the old layout" in the account menu (existing row; its wording is pinned by the DS-1 test, so it is unchanged).
  • A page that belongs to a space (Registration, QR Intake and Patient Records under Front desk; Bills to collect, Terminal Reconciliation and Daily cash closing under Billing; and so on) is listed under that space when the person can enter it. Otherwise it stays under More, so no page is lost. The space is shown in accent text while one of its pages is open; only the page itself is filled.
